text: この　ビルに　のりこんできた　やつらの　ボスは　めずらしい　つよい　ポケモンを　もとめて　いるって　いってた

structure.jp: この　ビルに　のりこんできた　やつらの　ボスは
structure.en: the boss of the guys who stormed into this building

structure.jp: めずらしい　つよい　ポケモンを　もとめて　いるって
structure.en: that he is looking for rare, strong Pokémon

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: この　ビルに　のりこんできた　やつら
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing or person describes them. この　ビルに　のりこんできた　やつら = 'the guys who stormed into this building'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: いるって　いってた
patterns.explanation: と after some words shows that they are what was said; って is the casual spoken form. もとめて　いるって　いってた = 'he said that he is looking for them'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now. もとめて　いる = 'is looking for'.
